linear-programming.upgrade: Original-space residual checks, optional row scaling, solver statuses; retain HiGHS.
linear-programming.mechanism: Only extend LP inside a certified MILP/solver workflow, not a neural LP replacement.

mixed-integer.upgrade: Integer residuals and original dual bound; feasible-incumbent local neighborhoods.
mixed-integer.mechanism: Propose free variables, solve bounded neighborhood, accept only an independently checked incumbent.

mosaic-multiobjective.upgrade: Keep v14 solver frozen; add independent objective/front audit; new experts remain candidates.
mosaic-multiobjective.mechanism: Evidence-triggered residual experts, frozen inactive RNG trajectory, no untested automatic promotion.

regression.upgrade: Train-only OLS/Ridge/Huber/GBDT selection; optional crossfit residual; separate conformal calibration.
regression.mechanism: Cheap shared predictor plus a validated residual expert; same output contract for optional foundation models.

time-series.upgrade: Nonoverlapping rolling-origin selection among trend, naive, seasonal and lagged models.
verifier: future-known covariates only in future adapter
time-series.mechanism: Choose by historical regime evidence, never assume a single foundation model dominates every horizon.

topsis.upgrade: Fixed external scale and ideals; explicit preference weights; Dirichlet rank acceptability; AHP consistency.
topsis.mechanism: Robust decision support, not a fabricated ground-truth ranking or automatic normative preferences.

graph-path.upgrade: Zero-edge-safe graph, negative-edge Bellman-Ford, checked A* hint with Dijkstra fallback.
graph-path.mechanism: Neural routing is a separate NP-hard TSP/VRP branch, not replacement of exact shortest paths.

ode.upgrade: Declared-stiffness DOP853/Radau, tolerance refinement, optional invariants and positivity checks.
ode.mechanism: Surrogate proposes, numerical residual and boundary conditions verify; no rigorous-error claim from two tolerances.

monte-carlo.upgrade: Replicated scrambled Sobol, independent-pilot control variates, honest total evaluation counts.
monte-carlo.mechanism: Learned sampling requires density/importance correction; never substitute biased generated samples for MC truth.

statistics.upgrade: Independent-unit aggregation, effect intervals, Holm/BH/BY, clustering diagnostics; separate classifier selection.
assumptions: no causal conclusion from prediction alone
statistics.mechanism: Uncertainty and selection risk need independent statistical evidence, not model self-confidence.
